asset_name: FLOWFORM LumenShell Robot and EV Battery V2 Concept

generation_provenance.method: OpenAI built-in image generation using two project-local reference images
generation_provenance.intended_use: bounded reviewer-facing robotics and electric-vehicle architecture concept

bounded_design_translation.cymatic_wave_channels: Candidate structural and acoustic damping-channel geometry using wave-shaped ribs, constrained damping inserts, and replaceable edge dissipaters. Energy dissipation is a hypothesis requiring modal, impact, material, and thermal testing.
bounded_design_translation.whitehole_blackhole_logic: A source/sink routing metaphor for intake aggregation, output distribution, bidirectional telemetry, heat rejection, and fault isolation. It does not refer to literal astrophysical objects, portals, free energy, or energy creation.
bounded_design_translation.honeycomb_battery: A separate electric-vehicle skateboard battery concept rather than a robot battery pack.
bounded_design_translation.robot_energy_storage: A compact protected service-battery enclosure distinct from the EV honeycomb architecture.

lumenshell_robot: practical wheeled mobile-manipulation platform with two articulated arms and a sensor mast
curved rigid-flex compute board retained inside the torso
wave-shaped shell channels and removable damping panels
compact protected robot service battery separated from the EV pack
visible service zones for compute, cooling, power routing, and maintenance
electric_vehicle_battery: full-scale low-profile skateboard pack shown outside the robot
segmented isolation walls, perimeter crush rails, liquid cooling, and pressure-relief intent
protected bus bars, module fusing, sensing, and service-disconnect intent
source_sink_routing: closed-loop copper and blue service pathways
dark aggregation hubs and pale distribution manifolds as visual routing cues
separation of sensing, control, power, cooling, and fault-isolation functions

claim_boundary: This image is an AI-generated industrial-design concept. It is not CAD, not a schematic, not a bill of materials, not executable robot or vehicle software, not a fabricated prototype, not test evidence, not a safety assessment or certification, and not patentability evidence. Cymatic describes a candidate wave-shaped structural geometry, not a validated resonance or energy-dissipation result. Whitehole/blackhole describes a bounded source/sink routing metaphor, not literal astrophysics, a portal, free energy, or energy creation. The image does not prove vibration reduction, impact attenuation, human safety, autonomy, payload, runtime, stability, battery performance, thermal performance, crashworthiness, reliability, manufacturability, commercial readiness, or regulatory compliance.
